# InNetworkNeuromorphicInference

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Deploying neuromorphic or model-as-chip inference directly within network infrastructure (e.g., switches, routers) to process data in transit. Bridges TCC and iNEST by enabling ultra-low-latency, energy-efficient AI processing at the network edge, reducing data movement overhead.
